reviews.author: Balachandar Jeldi
reviews.text:
No humanity
We faced a worst experience.
First, the receptionist is very rude. They give no respect for pregnant. Their response is very reckless. They kept wait for more than 2:30 hours to meet the doctor.

Second, the doctor is very calculated person. He will enquire our financial capacity by asking family details. Based on that, he will find a new thing like you have thyroid or BP or some thing else based on our financial status.

How can a pregnant lady can wait for such a long time by sitting in a chair??
